about_the_game:
CatMerge is a relaxing and fun merging game where you combine adorable cats to discover new species. Its simple gameplay makes it easy to pick up, but reaching the highest scores requires strategic thinking.

Merge tiny kittens and unlock surprising new forms. Each move leads you to bigger and cuter cats, but as the board fills up, every choice becomes more critical.

With its cozy atmosphere, soothing music, and charming visuals, CatMerge is more than just a game—it’s a delightful break to ease the stress of your day. Every run offers a new adventure and lets you expand your cat collection filled with cute combinations.

Your mission is simple: merge, grow, and aim for the highest score. But each new game brings fresh surprises that push you further.

Blending the cozy vibe with addictive arcade fun, CatMerge offers a sweet experience perfect for both quick sessions and long playtimes. So… can you unlock the biggest cat of them all? 🐾

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Runs on low-end systems. For stable 30+ FPS during intense enemy waves, the listed specs are recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth 60+ FPS at higher resolutions and with visual effects enabled.

short_description: CatMerge is an arcade game where you grow adorable cats by merging them. It’s easy to learn but delightful to master. With its cute visuals, relaxing atmosphere, and cats full of surprises, it offers a cozy experience at every moment. Perfect for fun, peaceful, and heartwarming times!
